about: Community directories Ootlebook shows next to the on-chain listings board, curated by the Ootlebook maintainer. Each listing is shown with its source and a link back; Ootlebook keeps only a cache it can rebuild. To suggest a source, open an issue or pull request. Anyone running their own reader can use a different list.

sources.name: Ootle Lobby
sources.note: Community-curated Ootle projects, contests and resources. Mirrored listing by listing from its public GitHub repo.

sources.name: Tari forum: Ootle Testnet Community Apps Directory
sources.note: A thread on the Tari community forum collecting apps live on the Ootle testnet. Read from its first post's quick-navigation list.
